source: public Instagram trend discovery (social.search, platform=instagram, ranked by engagement)

trends.details: A 6.7K-like reel runs six festive looks — a leopard-print blouse with brown fur trim, black velvet shorts, and black knee-high boots; a burgundy velvet pantsuit with black satin lapels; a black sleeveless turtleneck with a red sequin mini skirt and knee-high boots; a black long-sleeve sequin romper; a burgundy floral lace mini dress; and a black ruffled V-neck mini dress. A 6.1K-like try-on models a long brown satin maxi dress with a matching feather-trimmed capelet and a silver glitter clutch, a burgundy sequined mini dress with a square neckline and fluffy white heels, and a black velvet sweetheart-neck top tucked into a white pleated mini skirt. A 5.1K-like Anthropologie reel presents three holiday party outfits — a silver sequin maxi skirt with a white bralette and sheer shirt, pearl and crystal earrings, and a red plaid coat with a burgundy faux-fur collar; a cobalt blue satin gown with a light-blue faux-fur stole; and a black long-sleeve ruched turtleneck midi dress. A 4.8K-like Zara haul cycles through seven outfits — a burgundy velvet suit with a feather-cuff blazer; a white double-breasted blazer mini-dress; a black strapless bow top with sparkly flared trousers; a black embellished halter top with sheer lace flared pants; a brown tweed jacket with feather cuffs and satin burgundy trousers; a black velvet wrap suit with floral embroidery; and a silver sequined fringe mini dress. A 4.5K-like Walmart carousel, posted today, runs 17+ affordable festive looks — a red puff-sleeve top with a black sequin mini skirt and pearl-buckle heels, a red knit midi dress, sparkly wide-leg jeans, a white puff-sleeve corset top with a silver sequin skirt, and burgundy and black sequin halter mini dresses under $20. A 4.2K-like try-on runs seven looks including an all-white halter top with a satin maxi skirt, a black sequined velvet jumpsuit, and a grey knit two-piece set. A 3.8K-like H&M Partywear reel models three black evening outfits — a floor-length dress with side waist cutouts, a blazer-style mini dress with sheer tights and gold-tip heels, and a black lace high-neck top with a black velvet mini skirt.
trends.title: Velvet, sequins, and feather trims — holiday party looks from Zara, H&M, and Anthropologie

trends.details: A 92K-like DIY tutorial makes a 'Christmas baby face garland' — baby faces cut from printed photographs, Santa hats folded from festive paper with ricrac trim and pom-poms, threaded onto a dark green velvet ribbon and draped through the Christmas tree. A 73K-like reel, posted today, opens on a glamorous tree reveal — a woman in a red ruffled dress walks toward a large tree with gold ribbons, ornaments, and a star topper, flanked by illuminated wire reindeer and a life-size Santa statue, while two small dogs wander in. A 50K-like reel shows a child raising a wand toward a tall tree dressed entirely in red ornaments, berries, and silver tinsel — the white string lights suddenly switch on, wrapping the tree in bright light. A 37K-like reel preps a front entrance for Christmas — black lanterns with red velvet bows, small potted evergreens, a lighted branch tree in a woven basket, wire-frame reindeer, large gold jingle bells, and two green wreaths hung on the glass double doors. A 12K-like reel sends in a 'Santa Helpers' team — a flocked artificial tree with white and silver ornaments, polar bear figures, and a snowman base, plus garlands for the TV console and dining table. An 11K-like tutorial builds DIY balloon Christmas lights from inflated balloons topped with gold-painted paper cups and tinsel loops. Another 11K-like tutorial folds green paper circles into 3D paper trees with red bows and yellow stars, strung on twine as a garland. A 10K-like high-rise decorating reel assembles a tall Balsam Hill tree with warm white lights and long red velvet ribbons, then continues in nutcracker-print pajamas. A 10K-like reel makes a bauble garland by drilling holes through ornaments, threading them on white string, and draping the strands in swags around the tree.
trends.title: The lights switch on — baby-face garlands, wand-lit trees, and DIY bauble garlands

trends.details: A 16K-like reel presents a Thanksgiving dinner glam — short curly platinum-blonde hair, pink-purple eyeshadow, heavy contour and highlight, and glossy lips with a black turtleneck. A 15K-like close-up demos two glitter-infused lip balms — 'Fizzy Bubbles,' a sparkly mauve-pink, and 'Crystal Caviar,' a brown-berry glitter — swatched on the hand and worn over MAC lip liners. A 9.3K-like Maybelline ad runs a full routine — Grippy Serum primer, Super Stay Lumi-Matte Foundation, brown lip liner, a red matte lipstick, and a setting spray mist. A 5.3K-like full-glam tutorial works on a blonde model in pink satin pajamas — Artist Couture palettes, glitter pigment pressed on with fingers, LYS Beauty false lashes, Hourglass foundation, and a Scooby-Doo lip gloss. A 4.9K-like 'Christmas hair hack' dusts Fenty glitter through a section of hair for a sparkling effect. A 4.7K-like tutorial builds a 'Burgundy Christmas' eye — pink-burgundy shimmer on the lid and lower lash line, a reverse cut crease, and chunky glitter patted onto the center. A 3.5K-like reel, posted today, teaches a holiday glam eyeshadow — dramatic pink and burgundy smoky eyes with a bright shimmery center from the Blend Bunny palette, a neon yellow waterline, and a glossy brown lip. A 3.2K-like reel, also posted today, builds a Disney-inspired colorful eye — bright blue winged liner, purple-pink shimmer on the lid, and vibrant blue mascara on top and bottom lashes.
trends.title: Glitter lips, burgundy eyes, and Thanksgiving glam — holiday beauty goes maximal
